title: Overview: Indoor Aeroponic Tower Systems
description: Vertical towers misting plant roots with nutrients — maximum yield per square foot with minimal water. Feeding ten billion people while healing the planet is the defining challenge: these technologies grow more with less. This database covers all the pieces needed to make it: core components, materials, processes, software, and subsystems, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced. Every record is the full entry with definitions, key facts, and a runnable demo program.

title: Signature design: Glossary & Quick Reference
description: Signature design: The working vocabulary of Indoor Aeroponic Tower Systems: Yield, Fertigation, IPM, RAS, MRV, Biostimulant, Aquaponics, NDVI.
definition: Glossary for Indoor Aeroponic Tower Systems.
key_points: Yield: Output per area — the core productivity metric.
Fertigation: Delivering fertilizer through irrigation water.
IPM: Integrated pest management — combining control methods.
RAS: Recirculating aquaculture system — filtered fish farming.
MRV: Measurement, reporting, verification — for carbon credits.
Biostimulant: Substance boosting plant growth without being fertilizer.
Aquaponics: Fish plus plants in a recirculating loop.
NDVI: Satellite vegetation index measuring crop vigor.
how_it_works: Learn the terms before the details.
Use the demo as a flash drill.
Add your own terms as you learn.
Teach the vocabulary to your team.
